findings.summary: The packet set does not explicitly identify and serialize shared integration surfaces.

residualRisks: The 05 and 06 packets both authorize scripts/agent-context, scripts/agent-work, and scripts/verify-role-evidence.mjs, while the acceptance requires shared integration surfaces to be named separately and serialized. A dependency edge alone does not establish which contract each shared file integrates or prevent a later slice from weakening a predecessor contract.
